title: Identify artists who have illustrated cards that (a) are available in Japan
question: Identify artists who have illustrated cards that (a) are available in Japanese, (b) have at least one ruling whose text contains the word 'power', and (c) belong to sets that are not available on Magic: The Gathering Online. For each such artist, report whether any of their qualifying cards carry a content warning.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    c.XCL_002 AS artist,
    CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN c.XCL_064 IS NOT NULL AND c.XCL_064 != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
         THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_content_warning
FROM cards c
WHERE c.XCL_002 IS NOT NULL
  AND c.XCL_002 != ''
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM foreign_data fd
      WHERE fd.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072
        AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Japanese'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM rulings r
      WHERE r.XCL_090 = c.XCL_072
        AND r.XCL_089 LIKE '%power%'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sets s
      WHERE s.XCL_099 = c.XCL_063
        AND s.XCL_100 = 1
  )
GROUP BY c.XCL_002

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT c.XCL_002 AS artist,
       CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN c.XCL_012 IS NOT NULL AND c.XCL_012 != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
            THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_content_warning
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN set_translations st ON c.XCL_063 = st.XCL_093
INNER JOIN rulings r ON c.XCL_072 = r.XCL_090
LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086 AND l.XCL_084 = 'mtgo'
WHERE st.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
  AND r.XCL_089 LIKE '%power%'
  AND l.XCL_086 IS NULL
GROUP BY c.XCL_002
